entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tadeusz Ajdukiewicz was a Polish realist painter best known for his battle-scenes, portraits, landscapes and paintings of horses. He was educated in Kraków in the Austrian sector of the Partitioned Poland. He died in the armed struggle for Poland's independence around Kraków during World War I.
